  loader: reads the model's tensor groups from the .safetensors files, validates dtype and shape against the model config, and maps the BF16 buffers into pinned GPU device memory
  embed: gathers BF16 embedding rows by token ID from embed_tokens.weight into the initial hidden-state buffer for each position in the batch, and projects the final norm-ed hidden state to vocabulary logits via lm_head.weight
  layer_norm: applies a weighted RMS normalization in-place to the hidden state using one input_layernorm or post_attention_layernorm weight vector
  gdn: runs one GDN (linear-attention) sub-layer: projects the hidden state to (qkv, z, a, b) via in_proj_*, applies the depthwise conv1d, runs the selective-scan recurrence with A_log and dt_bias, applies the sub-layer norm, gates by z, and projects back to hidden size via out_proj
  qsa: runs one QSA (full-attention) sub-layer: projects the hidden state to (q, k, v) via q_proj, k_proj and v_proj, applies per-head q_norm and k_norm, applies mRoPE, appends to the KV cache, and projects the attended output back to hidden size via o_proj
  moe: runs one MoE FFN block: multiplies the hidden state by mlp.gate.weight to get router logits, selects top-8 experts (kernels in u12d8dd5102), runs the shared expert (gate_proj, up_proj → SwiGLU → down_proj), gates the shared contribution with shared_expert_gate, and sums all contributions
